title: LearningLaxPairs-SILO: code and run logs for "Learning Lax Pairs: Revisiting the Classical Paradigm"
description: Python scripts and archived run logs for the multi-seed SILO (Sparse Identification of Lax Operators) searches reported in Appendix A.4 of J. Adriazola, G. Biondini, W. Zhu, and P. G. Kevrekidis, Learning Lax Pairs: Revisiting the Classical Paradigm, Studies in Applied Mathematics (2026), arXiv:2607.01493. Includes exact symbolic checks with SymPy.
